author: MLGtino
body:
Here's what I need from you guys.
I'd like you to discuss:
- What you consider inappropriate (could be general, could be specifically listing certain things that just don't fly).
- An example of something you'd consider inappropriate (not blatantly inappropriate).
- An example of something you'd consider server appropriate (not something that's obviously allowed like JohnSmith26 or whatever).
- Whether or not you feel that people should be banned for inappropriate names, feel free to discuss why if necessary.

I think the easiest way to tell if a person's name is appropraite or not is if you put it through the "IRL test"
If you can say it (or show it) to a random person in real life, would they find it offensive?

Other than that, I think it just takes common sense to tell if a name is intentionally being offensive or not.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Obviously, the derogatory term that would come to mind is "faggot".
But considering that name has no reference to homophobia and the fact that this name is not intended to be offensive means that this name is deemed not offensive. 

Although, the player would have to explain himself to multiple people and staff about why his name isn't offensive. This name could also cause confusion. 

Although this name is fine and is allowed on our servers, I would personally recommend changing the name to avoid the confusion.

Edit: This can be explained for "iluvpussycat" too.

In these cases, the names aren't offensive, the only person who makes these names seem offensive is you.
So in these cases, it's actually you who should change, not the player.

(I'm using "you" in a general sense, not you specifically Stimulating).

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Appropriate: YouSuckAss, BlackNipplesFTW - Actual people who have come on Avicus.
Justification: First off, most of us have established that "ass" doesn't really offend people and isn't considered very inappropriate at all. The argument from the Moderators who banned him was "What if I don't want to suck an ass?"  and "He's telling the person in the death message to suck ass."  Lastly, if that name were inappropriate, Gonzo (xgonzo_kick_assx) would have been banned a long time ago. As for "BlackNipplesFTW", I wouldn't even have considered banning. There's no curse word in it, and if it were WhiteNipplesFTW or simply NipplesFTW, nobody would have even bothered to think about it. 
Inappropriate: Anything with excessive swearing, racist or homophobic slurs, something that offends a specific religion, etc.
